coordinateConvention: H: threshold origin; x+ exterior right / interior left when facing front door; y+ inside; z+ up. Story-scale approximate coordinates, not surveyed geometry.
continuityRules: Window002 is exterior LEFT / interior RIGHT of front door. Do not mirror kitchen to chase screen direction.
PinPin is the mobile child and messenger. PomPom is an infant; he remains in Mama arms, not a second running child.
Mama faces bread counter and has not seen Papa before the news. Her delight follows PinPin report.
One brass knob; hinges exterior LEFT / interior RIGHT; leaf opens outward toward exterior left.
Papa broad mature cream face and readable hazel eyes. Scooby soft animated-feature brown dog; no pet-photo texture.
Three household hedgehogs indoors before Papa enters, exactly four family hedgehogs at reunion; no duplicate baby or extra child.
Doorstep hug005 and all later images are retained; insertions develop cause and response.
